Demo_01_Floating_Input__small.v.description: Small presentation demo: U1 reads missing_signal, a net with no driver. Expected result: floating_net error.

Demo_02_Two_Drivers__small.v.description: Small presentation demo: U1 and U2 both drive shared_net. Expected result: multi_driver error.

Demo_03_Dead_Logic__small.v.description: Small presentation demo: U2 and U3 cannot affect y. Expected result: no_path_to_po warning.

Demo_cut_carry__Validate_add_mul_8_bit_S.description: Cut the carry link adder_1/intadd_0/U6.CO -> adder_1/intadd_0/U5.CI (net \adder_1/intadd_0/n5).

Demo_float_net__Train_add_mul_comp_sub_4.description: Reconnected pin CI of adder_1/U7 (ADDF_X1M_A9TH) from \adder_1/n4 to a new undriven net n100060; adder_1/U6.CO now drives nothing.

Demo_miswire_bits__Test_add_mul_16_bit_S.description: Swapped operand bits b[1] and b[0]: adder_1/U68.A now reads b[0] and adder_1/U36.B now reads b[1]. The netlist stays electrically valid.
